newsitem.headline: MILAN, Aug 18 (Reuter) - Italy's blue-chip Mib30 stock index slid 2.76.

text.p: percent to 21,156 at the opening following steep losses in U.S. markets on Friday.
The all-share Mibtel fell 2.64 percent to 14,025 at market open.
By 0805 GMT the Mib30 index was 2.33 percent off at 21,239 while the Mibtel was 2.33 percent down at 14070. The September Fib 30 futures contract was 2.66 percent weaker at 21335.
